summary: JIT grill of per-event-files against spec, decisions 0022/0045/0046, and completed work. Three design points (placement, filename scheme, legacy fate) resolved; contract kept, resolutions are implementation guidance.
current_flow: append_event appends one JSON line to the shared .factory/events.jsonl, which needs a per-clone merge=union driver (.gitattributes) that interleaves/tears lines across worktrees. load_events reads only events.jsonl (tolerating torn lines). board and forge history read via load_events. Task 3 makes append_event write per-event files and load_events read both, retiring the union driver.

criteria_map.recording an event creates a new file an: test_append_event_writes_new_file_no_shared_ledger records an event and asserts a new .factory/events/<unique>.json exists and events.jsonl is unchanged (no append)
criteria_map.forge history renders legacy and per-fil: test_history_merges_legacy_and_per_file_events seeds a legacy events.jsonl plus per-event files and asserts load_events/forge history returns both, ordered, with story/event/since/until filters intact

new_abstractions: append_event writes .factory/events/<iso>-<seq/id>.json (0022 pattern, collision-free across worktrees); load_events unions per-event files + legacy events.jsonl. Reversible: legacy events.jsonl stays readable; no caller or board change (single-source).

rounds.question: Freeze legacy events.jsonl read-only after retiring the union driver?

citations.finding: One record per file removes the conflict; retire the union driver
Events touch no deferred consumer, so retirement is unconditional and marker-neutral

gaps: Freeze legacy events.jsonl read-only after retiring the union driver?
resolutions: Flat .factory/events/ dir, UNCONDITIONAL (operator 2026-08-18): append_event always writes .factory/events/<unique>.json regardless of the scoped-layout marker. Events are conflict-free by unique name and no deferred consumer reads them, so this retires the union driver now and stays marker-neutral per 0046; events keep their 'story' field for load_events filtering. Overrides the objective's 'under the story directory' wording.

0022 pattern naming (operator 2026-08-18): reuse the lessons/quickfix ledger convention (<iso>-<seq>-<actor/id>.json) that already guarantees collision-free names across concurrent worktrees and that forge history already reads.

Freeze events.jsonl read-only (operator 2026-08-18): append_event never appends to it again, so it becomes static and conflict-free even after merge=union is removed from .gitattributes; load_events keeps reading it. No migration/deletion here (that, if ever, is migration-and-vendor).
